title: In Medias Res — A Storytelling Masterstroke
skills: identify in medias res in narrative texts
analyze how beginning in the middle of the action affects engagement
explain how narrative structure shapes pacing and suspense
evaluate authorial choices in story openings
alignment_note: Explores in medias res as a storytelling technique that begins a narrative in the midst of significant action. Reinforces analysis of narrative structure, pacing, suspense, reader engagement, and intentional authorial choices across high school English courses.
